initial_prompt: How do I center a div?

messages.content: How do I center a div?

Centering a `div` is the most famous problem in CSS, but modern CSS has made it much easier.

Here are the **four best ways** to do it, ranked from "Modern Standard" to "Old School."

### 1. The Modern Standard (Flexbox)
**Use this for almost everything.** It is the most reliable way to center content horizontally and vertically.

Apply this CSS to the **Parent Container**:
```css
.parent {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center; /* Centers Horizontally */
  align-items: center;     /* Centers Vertically */
  height: 100vh;           /* Parent needs height to see vertical centering */
}
```

---

### 2. The Shortest Way (CSS Grid)
This is the newest method. It achieves the exact same result as Flexbox but requires one less line of code.

Apply this CSS to the **Parent Container**:
```css
.parent {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;     /* Centers Horizontally AND Vertically */
  height: 100vh;
}
```

---

### 3. Horizontal Only (Margin Auto)
**Use this if you only need to center left-to-right.** This is the classic way to center a main content block on a website. Note that the child `div` **must** have a defined width.

Apply this CSS to the **Child Div** (the one you want to center):
```css
.child-div {
  width: 50%;        /* Must have a width */
  margin: 0 auto;    /* 0 top/bottom, auto left/right */
}
```

---

### 4. For Overlays/Popups (Absolute Position)
**Use this for modals or floating elements.** This removes the div from the normal document flow, allowing it to sit on top of other things.

Apply this CSS to the **Child Div**:
```css
.child-div {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
```
*(Note: The parent container must have `position: relative` for this to work relative to that container.)*

### Summary: Which one should I choose?
*   **Most of the time:** Use **Method 1 (Flexbox)**.
*   **If you want less code:** Use **Method 2 (Grid)**.
*   **If you just want a centered block of text:** Use **Method 3 (Margin Auto)**.
